result.stdout:
usage: coreidml <command> [arguments] [--pretty]

  summary <file.idml> [--runs] [--max-text maxTextLength] [--pages pages] [--sections sections]
      pages, frames, stories, links, styles (idml_summarize)
  story <file.idml> <storyId> [--paragraphs]
      one story with indexed content runs (idml_get_story)
  find <file.idml> [--text text] [--name name] [--label label] [--tag tag] [--kind kind] [--page pageIndex] [--max maxResults]
      frames and stories by name, label, tag, kind or text (idml_find)
  validate <file.idml>
      structural validation (idml_validate)
  structure <file.idml>
      XML structure tree (idml_xml_structure)
  export-xml <file.idml> [--at at]
      the XML structure as XML (idml_export_xml)
  diff <before> <after>
      what changed between two files (idml_diff)
  set-text <file.idml> <storyId> <run> <text> [--force] [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      replace one content run's text (idml_set_text)
  relink <file.idml> <linkId> <uriOrPath> [--refit] [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      point a link at another file (idml_relink_image)
  replace <file.idml> <find> <replacement> [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      find and replace in every story (idml_replace_text)
  fill <file.idml> <data.json> [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      fill a template from {"text":{...},"images":{...}} (idml_fill)
  import-xml <file.idml> <data.xml> [--at at] [--fit fit] [--char-style characterStyles] [--relink-only] [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      import XML onto the structure (idml_import_xml)
  merge <file.idml> <other.idml>... [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      append pages of other files (other.idml@0,2 takes pages 0 and 2) (idml_merge)
  apply <file.idml> <spec.json> [-o outPath] [--in-place] [--dry-run]
      add a JSON spec's colours, styles and pages (idml_apply)
  to-pdf <file.idml> [-o outPath] [--fonts fonts] [--links linkDirectories] [--pages pages] [--max-dpi maxImageDpi] [--jpeg-quality jpegQuality] [--options options]
      render to PDF; re
[truncated]
